name: streetwear-edit
description: Build a fit around sneakers, layers and budget.

interface.longDescription: Build a fit around sneakers, layers and budget. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Build a streetwear fit; Compare layer sizes; Plan a wear rotation. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me build a streetwear fit.

prompts: Help me build a streetwear fit.
Help me plan a wear rotation.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Layer Kit: Streetwear workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Build a streetwear fit. Reproducible inputs: {"budget":200,"items":[{"name":"Tee","category":"top","price":30,"tags":["relaxed"]},{"name":"Cargo pants","category":"bottom","price":70,"tags":["utility"]},{"name":"Sneakers","category":"shoes","price":90,"tags":["low-top"]}]}
positive.prompt: Help me build a streetwear fit with these supplied values: {"budget":200,"items":[{"name":"Tee","category":"top","price":30,"tags":["relaxed"]},{"name":"Cargo pants","category":"bottom","price":70,"tags":["utility"]},{"name":"Sneakers","category":"shoes","price":90,"tags":["low-top"]}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses streetwear_edit_outfit_budget with the supplied inputs. Returns {"total":190,"remaining":10,"missing_slots":[],"items":[{"name":"Tee","category":"top","price":30,"tags":["relaxed"]},{"name":"Cargo pants","category":"bottom","price":70,"tags":["utility"]},{"name":"Sneakers","category":"shoes","price":90,"tags":["low-top"]}]}. Shows the actual outfit result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.prompt: Help me compare layer sizes with these supplied values: {"base_chest_cm":110,"outer_chest_cm":124,"chosen_ease_cm":10,"base_length_cm":72,"outer_length_cm":66}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses streetwear_edit_layer_check with the supplied inputs. Returns {"chest_difference_cm":14,"meets_chosen_ease":true,"base_visible_length_cm":6,"note":"Garment measurements only; stretch and cut can change the real fit."}. Shows the actual layers result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Plan a wear rotation. Reproducible inputs: {"days":["Mon","Tue","Wed"],"preferred_tag":"everyday","pairs":[{"name":"Canvas pair","tags":["everyday"]},{"name":"Leather pair","tags":["everyday"]}]}
positive.prompt: Help me plan a wear rotation with these supplied values: {"days":["Mon","Tue","Wed"],"preferred_tag":"everyday","pairs":[{"name":"Canvas pair","tags":["everyday"]},{"name":"Leather pair","tags":["everyday"]}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses streetwear_edit_sneaker_rotation with the supplied inputs. Returns {"rotation":[{"day":"Mon","pair":"Canvas pair"},{"day":"Tue","pair":"Leather pair"},{"day":"Wed","pair":"Canvas pair"}],"note":"A user-controlled rotation, not live stock or trend ranking."}. Shows the actual calendar result. Does not fabricate external data.
